title: Greater Niagara
summary: A profile of the industrial ecosystem across the Niagara area in New York and Ontario.
why: The industrial system here crosses that border, and a shared set of topics is how the two sides can be read together.
span: Greater Niagara is the name of this subsite. Niagara Region, the Ontario upper-tier municipality, is one place inside the area, not the name of the whole.
